title: Sukkā (2)
text: 1. Ekam samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe || [page 213] X. 12.] YAKKHA-SAṂYUTTA X. 213 2. Tena kho pana samayena aññataro upāsako Sukkāya bhikkhuniyā bhojanam adāsi || || 3. Atha kho Sukkāya bhikkhuniyā abhippasanno yakkho Rājagahe rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā tāyaṃ velāyam imaṃ gātham abhāsi || || Puññaṃ vata pasavi bahuṃ || sapañño vatāyam upāsako || yo Sukkāya adāsi bhojanaṃ || sabbaganthehi vippamuttiyā ti || ||
